description:
Is this the ultimate mindset trick?  What happens for you?  Let me know in the comments. 😊 

New Instructions for 2024

Become alert  ask the question and watch for the thoughts  like a cat watching a mouse hole. What happens next?

It’s easy to think any new thought after all we are thinking machines but this exercise is about watching for the next thought. 👀

Mindfully practice being the observer of your thoughts instead of automatically being the thinker. 🤔

If you struggle with this, let me know in the comments. ❤️

If you need any help with your mindset, please reach out for a mindset coaching, links are in my bio.  Also do check out the mindset change podcast. 
.
#mindfulness #Anxiety #spiritualawakening #mindset #mindhack #powerofnow #eckharttolle #stress #overthinking #negativethoughts

And then direct your attention to your thoughts, to your mind. And then ask yourself mentally this one question.
